task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel Raman benchmark chart, variant 05. Scenario: data, fit, baseline.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel Raman spectrum benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel Raman spectrum with one fully enclosed plotting frame and an in-panel legend at upper right. The visible letters D and G mark spectral peaks, not panel labels. No inset or shared external axis/legend is present.

x.visible_pattern: Tick labels increase uniformly from 500 to 2500 with evenly spaced tick marks across the bottom axis.
x.justification: Axis-fit validation chose a linear model; normalized RMSE was approximately 0.0003, far better than log10.

y.visible_pattern: Tick labels run from 0 to 700 in 100-unit steps with evenly spaced tick marks on the left axis.
y.justification: Axis-fit validation chose a linear model; normalized RMSE was approximately 0.0003, and log10 is incompatible with the visible zero tick.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: No separate recoverable hidden segments are apparent beyond deliberate coincident styling.

curves.overlap_notes: Black solid data is only visibly separable in the peak region and through dash gaps of the overlaid blue fit; the flat tails were truncated instead of borrowing the coincident baseline/fit path.
curves.suspected_gap_notes: Most of the underlying black centerline is hidden by the blue dashed fit outside the peak region.

curves.overlap_notes: Blue dashed fit was kept only over the clearly visible peak-region dashes; the nearly coincident flat tails were truncated to avoid mixing with the red baseline and black data.
curves.suspected_gap_notes: Short hidden dash gaps remain inside the visible segment, but no separate recoverable continuation beyond the truncated tails is warranted.

curves.overlap_notes: Red dash-dot baseline is horizontal and visible across the plot, though its tails are repeatedly crossed by the spectrum trace.

response.interpretation_notes: Single Raman spectrum panel with a black data trace, a blue dashed fit, and a red horizontal baseline. The fit and data are strongly coincident on the tails, so both were revised to conservative peak-region segments while the baseline remained unchanged.
unresolved_ambiguities: The black data trace is mostly hidden beneath the blue dashed fit, so only the clearly visible peak-region black segments are retained and it is not suitable for normalization.
The blue fit and red baseline are nearly coincident on the flat tails; those tail sections were intentionally omitted from the fit trace to avoid cross-label contamination.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
